description: Dataset for a Norwegian high-voltage distribution system (SecurEL reference system) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Susanne Sandell, Sigurd Hofsmo Jakobsen (SINTEF Energy Research). Dataset for a Norwegian high-voltage distribution system (SecurEL reference system) This dataset represents a simplified, anonymized 132/66 kV Norwegian high-voltage (HV) distribution grid. Load and generation data are provided at hourly resolution over four years (2019-2022). The dataset also includes historical reliability data (failure rates), future load-development scenarios, and ambient-adjusted line ratings. Coverage: national (NO); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
